title: Re-Volt
text:
Re-Volt is a 3D racing game developed and published by Acclaim Entertainment in 1999 for Windows, Nintendo 64, PlayStation, Dreamcast, 2012 for iPhone, and iPad, and 2013 for Android.

Story
In this game, you are in role of racer controlling remote control cars built by fictional toy company called Toy-Volt whose popularity skyrocketed after producing toys for children all over the world by using their special secret ingredient to made their radio controlled cars come to life, gain minds of their own, and start racing all around the world.

Gameplay
Re-Volt is single player and multiplayer racing game that includes 15 tracks and 31 RC cars to unlock and drive, and 11 collectible Power-Ups gained by grabbing Pick Ups scattered throughout each track.
